patch_description: Replace the placeholder with a hardcoded, locally-refined configuration of 11 points. Start from a known-good structured arrangement (boundary + interior points based on known good Heilbronn solutions for n=11) and refine with a short deterministic gradient-free optimization (coordinate perturbation with fixed seed) maximizing the minimum triangle area. To keep eval_time low, use a modest iteration budget and vectorized area computation over all C(11,3)=165 triplets. The score benchmark is ~0.0365 normalized; a good 11-point arrangement should reach a large fraction of that, hopefully above 1.0. Include error handling: if optimization fails or produces infeasible points, fall back to the initial structured arrangement.
